description: Rebuild remaining page-specific stylesheets (owner.css, redesign-lecture.css, redesign-matrix.css) to align with the new design language, and do a final consistency pass to ensure everything is unified.
steps: Rewrite frontend/src/styles/owner.css to use the new design tokens consistently. Key changes: (1) Timeline: Keep the structure but use new token values for borders, spacing, transitions. Remove any old token references (--radius-lg should be --r-lg). (2) Toggle switch: Update to use new tokens. (3) Event icons: Keep the color variants. (4) Any component that references old MD3 tokens (--md-outline-variant, --md-surface-container-low, etc.) should be updated to use the new semantic tokens (--border, --surface-1, etc.).

Rewrite frontend/src/styles/redesign-lecture.css to align with the new design system. Key changes: (1) Replace all old token references (--radius-lg) with new ones (--r-lg). (2) Keep the video container overlay gradient. (3) Keep the floating progress bar but simplify. (4) Meta bar: use new glass tokens.

Rewrite frontend/src/styles/redesign-matrix.css to align with the new design system. Key changes: (1) Replace --radius-lg with --r-lg. (2) Replace --md-outline-variant with --border. (3) Replace --md-surface-container-low with --surface-1. (4) Keep the mini progress ring structure (conic-gradient). (5) Course header gradient: simplify to use new tokens.

Final consistency pass on frontend/src/styles/app.css - verify all the responsive media queries at the bottom of the file still work correctly. Ensure: (1) Sidebar collapses properly on tablet/mobile. (2) Bottom nav shows at <= 768px. (3) Grid layouts collapse properly. (4) Content padding reduces on mobile. (5) No class name was accidentally removed during the rewrite.

Verify frontend/src/main.tsx import order is still correct and all CSS files are imported. The load order matters: tokens.css first (defines variables), then page-specific sheets, then app.css (overrides), then pdf.css.
Check frontend/index.html - ensure the Google Fonts link is still present and correctly loading IBM Plex Sans Arabic with weights 300,400,500,600,700 and Space Mono with weights 400,700.
acceptance_criteria: owner.css uses only tokens defined in the new tokens.css (no old MD3 references like --md-outline-variant in page-specific CSS)
redesign-matrix.css uses --r-lg, --border, --surface-1 instead of old MD3 tokens
All responsive breakpoints in app.css are preserved and functional
index.html still loads IBM Plex Sans Arabic and Space Mono fonts
The entire platform uses one cohesive visual language
No CSS file references a variable that does not exist in tokens.css
verification: Search all CSS files for references to undefined variables (any --md-* token that was removed from tokens.css)
Verify main.tsx imports all 9 CSS files in the correct order
Verify index.html contains the Google Fonts link
Check that all CSS files have valid syntax (balanced braces)
